text_block_list.text:
Christmas Eve. A scream, utterly unfitting 
for a holy night, roared through the town.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Thief! Stop right there!

If there's a thief, I can't just ignore 
it. I chase after the fleeing figure. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¿Qué!? Trainer-san...

The figure was, without a doubt, El Condor 
Pasa.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So... you found me...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I am the elusive, enigmatic figure 
racing through the holy night like Santa 
Claus—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It is I, Phantom Thief El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait, wait! Please don't 
misunderstand, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, *ahem*. El is a phantom thief, not a 
common burglar.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I was actually just doing something else 
in this form, yes.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, it is handing out Christmas 
presents, of course, DESU!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El is a celebrity now! And in El's 
country, it's totally normal for 
celebrities to donate!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I heard that in Japan, masked wrestlers 
give out school backpacks to children, 
too.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So, I was just secretly delivering 
presents to the children, you see!
choice_data_list:
If you're going to volunteer, you should 
just do it normally.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... there is a reason it 
cannot be made public, yes...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That is... And what might that reason 
be...!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A phantom thief must never reveal their 
true identity to anyone, you seeee!

In short... she just wanted to bask in the 
feeling of being a phantom thief.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please, let El off the hook this 
time!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El still has a mission to deliver lots and 
lots of presents, desu! That is why, desu!

Having been asked, I decided to look the 
other way. Still, sneaking around like 
this isn't right.
choice_data_list:
At least make sure to get permission from 
an adult.

At least make sure you get permission from 
an adult, okay?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! You have a point. If we only tell 
the adults, we won't crush the kids' 
dreams, after all.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I promise, Trainer! Well then, I shall 
take my leave.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ciao!

Swishing their cape, they departed. With 
this, they should be able to play Santa 
without a hitch.
And then, shortly after that...
(Wee-woo! Pee-po-pee-po!)

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Wait! Thieeeef!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's not it, no way! El is not a thief, 
no, sir!

El Condor Pasa gets chased around by the 
children. In the end, it seems they still 
treated her like a thief.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El still has a mission to deliver lots and 
lots of presents, desu! That is why, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¿Qué? Why is that~?

"Instead, you tell him to proudly hand the 
present to the child himself."

"I'm wearing a mask anyway, so there's no 
way anyone will figure out my identity, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oho, you're right! A blind spot, an 
oversightâEl is still inexperienced not 
to have thought of that!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Understood-desu! Then let's gather the 
children at the park and give out the 
presents!
(Clang, clang!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is gathered, YES? On this 
Christmas night, swooping in and slashing 
through, the Phantom Thief has arrived!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"For the good girls, this phantom thief 
has a very special present!"

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Wooww, it's El Condor Pasa! El Condor 
Pasa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not true! El is a phantom 
thief, definitely not El Condor Pasa...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Now, give me the present!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Forget the presents, shake my hand, shake 
it! And give me a hug, too~♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, this is an unexpected development! 
Take turns, take turns, DESU!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ayayayaya~!

El Condor Pasa gets mobbed by the 
children. They seemed far happier with 
that than receiving any gift.
